properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR is the keystore v3 cipher protecting every wallet private key this app creates. 128-bit is above the 112-bit floor and not urgent under Grover, but below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 requirement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is the password-to-key KDF for the wallet keystore file. The weak default n=4096 materially weakens brute-force resistance of user wallet files; changeable here (bundle parameters), though keystore files already written stay readable under whatever params they carry.
